It includes the professional intro paragraph, basic info (work status, location, authorizations), contact information (LinkedIn, GitHub, email, portfolio), current activities, recently concluded work, and a personal quote.

about.intro_para: Software Engineer with a Master's degree in Systems Engineering and 2+ years of professional experience developing enterprise software, I have built several production-ready projects across distributed systems, full-stack applications, backend services, and Microsoft's cloud and data ecosystem. I combine strong engineering fundamentals with a product mindset, using user needs and data-driven decision-making to architect scalable systems and deliver modular, maintainable codebases built to production standards, both individually and in collaborative teams.

currently.text: Actively handling the end-to-end operations and engineering of Hive [1], a real-time topic based internet town square. As of June'26, successfully handling 40+ users and 2.8k+ messages with $0 operational costs [2]

Providing end-to-end engineering services on a project basis in every major tech areas like cross platform software development, system architecture designing, AI projects, database management, hosting and maintenance services and software consultations to small businesses and startups [1].

recently_concluded.text: Concluded the work on one my client's online presence including their website, SEO [1] and initiated a long-term partnership for their website maintenance and hosting services [2]
Concluded my journey of sharpening my skills in the fields of Data Structures, Algorithms, System Architecture Design and Low Level Programming via online platforms like Leetcode and HelloInterview

about.outer_para: I am always eager to collaborate on solving problems and contributing to the growth of a cause. Feel free to contact me via LinkedIn or email.
about.my_quote: Lets hope for the best and plan for the worst
